files.name: concepticon.tsv
files.desc: The 4,165 concept sets: ID, English GLOSS, SEMANTICFIELD, DEFINITION, ONTOLOGICAL_CATEGORY.

files.name: conceptlists.tsv
files.desc: Metadata for the ~160 source concept lists (Swadesh lists, naming tests, elicitation lists) that reference concept IDs above — which fieldwork list, which languages it was collected in, citation.

files.name: conceptrelations.tsv
files.desc: Typed relations between concept sets (e.g. broader/narrower, part-whole) — the ontological structure connecting the flat concept list.
